name: @agiterra/wire-grok
description: Grok adapter for The Wire — two process layers, one package. (1) Sidecar parent: holds the one SSE and injects via grok agent stdio ACP session/prompt. Analog of codex-wire. (2) Grok plugin: MCP tools (set_plan/heartbeat/register) + skills. No in-process SSE. Outbound is wire-ipc (separate plugin).
author: Tim Garthwaite <https://github.com/mividtim>
